name: DSW Diamond Star Title
epitaph: Changed hands twice in five months -- won in a Gauntlet Rumble, forfeited, then won again by pinfall -- before settling on its reigning champion as of July 2003.

name: DSW Shooting Star Title
epitaph: Won in a ladder match in April 2003 and still held by the same champion as of the promotion's own July 2003 rankings.

name: DSW Gemini Titles
epitaph: The promotion's own tag-team championship, won in April 2003 and, by its own account, suspended soon after for want of an active tag-team division.
